summary: The Dreamer can now check a candidate lexeme against web_search before recording it as room-coined slang, catching real-world things (e.g. a game the group actually plays) that were being flagged as if this group invented them.
details: Confirmed false positive on live traffic: "Big Walk", an actual game already tracked elsewhere, was recorded as a room lexicon entry.

Off by default behind a new [language].verify_known_entities gate, separate from turning [search] on for the chat agent — it costs an extra search credit and model completion per candidate, so it is an explicit opt-in, not implied by the other two flags.
Fails open on any verification failure (search unavailable, unparseable classification) — a candidate is only ever dropped on a positive match, never on uncertainty.
limitations: Extraction quality is unchanged — this only narrows what extraction already found, it does not catch anything extraction missed.
